name: omaplay
author: T3 Venture Labs
description: Bar widget and mini player for omaplay, the Omarchy-themed media player based on VLC. Requires the omaplay player.

barWidget.description: Now playing, transport, seek and volume for omaplay, in the bar.

schema.label: Maximum title width
schema.description: Pixels the title may take in the bar. 0 shows only the icon.

schema.label: Hide when omaplay is not running
schema.description: Hide the widget while omaplay is closed. The keybinding targets keep working.
